scope: Targeted primary-source review, not exhaustive novelty clearance

readings.title: Distilling Step-by-Step
readings.coverage: Rechecked abstract and §3.1–3.2, equations 1–4, task prefixes; experiments and appendices not reread this turn.
readings.finding: Rationale generation as an auxiliary task while predicting the label directly at deployment is established. The paper also distinguishes rationale-conditioned prediction. Current weighted cross entropy and task routing are controls, not a new loss.
readings.not_established: Any transfer gain on our 3D data.

readings.title: SPHERE
readings.coverage: Read §2.1–2.3 methods, §3 study design, reported primary results and §6–7 limitations. No figure-by-figure review or reproduction.
readings.finding: Uses Holodeck, post-session preference memory from edits and terminal geometry, hierarchical spatial constraints, and reward-updated retrieval rerankers. The controlled profiles and lack of explicit conflict relaxation limit general personalization claims. Memory, functional abstraction and user-conditioned constraints are overlapping ideas.
readings.code_check: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE currently displays README only and says implementation will be released; not an executable control verified here.

readings.title: RoomWright
readings.coverage: Read method overview, Algorithm 1, task-centric expansion, interaction induction, layout/critic pipeline, usage-facing orientation, main evaluation protocol/table, appendices E–G. Not full appendix A prompts/C formulas or all experiments/figures.
readings.finding: Already combines usage-driven object/support/interaction planning, executable asset code, geometric layout solving, visual critique and physical validation. Its task scope includes interaction behavior absent from our current furniture targets. Adding a usage rationale before geometric tools is not enough to distinguish a method.
readings.not_established: Author implementation availability, reproduced results or direct superiority over our system.
